problem_text:
A logistics coordinator needs to assign packages to identical delivery trucks.  
Packages:  
* Package 1: size 47 cubic feet  
* Package 2: size 61 cubic feet  
* Package 3: size 55 cubic feet  
* Package 4: size 30 cubic feet  
* Package 5: size 49 cubic feet  
* Package 6: size 63 cubic feet  
* Package 7: size 48 cubic feet  
* Package 8: size 65 cubic feet  
* Package 9: size 60 cubic feet  
* Package 10: size 32 cubic feet  
* Package 11: size 64 cubic feet  
* Package 12: size 66 cubic feet  
* Package 13: size 65 cubic feet  
* Package 14: size 46 cubic feet  
* Package 15: size 32 cubic feet  
* Package 16: size 59 cubic feet  
* Package 17: size 55 cubic feet  
* Package 18: size 37 cubic feet  

Each truck has a maximum capacity of 100 cubic feet. Assign all packages using the fewest trucks possible. Every package must be placed in exactly one truck, and the total volume in a truck cannot exceed its capacity.
